default/31001.htm.text: Claudia Athebaldt: I will tell you a story, one of ancient immorality. Once there lived a beautiful princess, in a far away land. Her beauty was so renowned that her mother, the Queen, grew jealous and plotted to have her killed. When the King discovered her evil plot he tried to stop it. This enra…

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/31001-0.text: Lady Claudia: There you are! I've heard plenty about you already; in fact I've not heard my husband mention someone quite so glowingly in quite some time. I've also heard your training sessions with Collin are over?

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Lady Claudia: Good, let's get started.

links.text: "I assume your plan has me disguised?"

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Lady Claudia: (This quest may only be taken by a character who is level 79 or higher, who has already completed the Seven Signs, Contract of Mammon quests.)
Lady Claudia: What are you still doing here!!! Hurry to the Gludio Village and find Master Guard of Dawn John . He has the Identity Card of the Guards of the Dawn that I need.

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/31001-01.html.text: Claudia Athebalt: Magister Hannellin told me that you would be coming. Do you have the letter? Very well. You will find the ark in the Cemetery of Kings . It is locked and can only be opened with the key. It is said that the key is in the possession of the guardian of the ark .

links.text: "Tell me more about the guardian of the ark."

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/31001-03.html.text: Claudia Athebalt: Have you defeated the Guardian of the Ark yet? No? Many must think that I've squandered my life in service to god, and I am certainly not your average member of the aristocracy, but my rebellious streak comes naturally. I would hate myself if I denied it. Dignity is the most impor…

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/31001-04.html.text: Claudia Athebalt: Ah! Could it be? Is it the key to the ark? You mustn't waste any time, go to the cemetery and open the bloody thing! I have no idea what is in it, you must simply take whatever it is, along with the other two sacred relics, to Magister Hanellin. She will know what to do. Farewell,…

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/31001-02.html.text: Lady Claudia: This is "The Revelation of the Seals"! Many wish to possess this book, my husband foremost among them.... I appreciate your hard work and hope this reward shows you just how grateful I am to you.

Q00372_LegacyOfInsolence/31001-01.html.text: Lady Claudia: Have you brought "The Revelation of the Seals"? Remember - once you've collect all seven books, bring them straight to me! The Lords of Dawn have very high expectations of you!

Q00194_SevenSignsMammonsContract/31001-0.text: Lady Claudia: Excellent news. I am so very thankful to Priest Cain for getting you involved in the Order of the Dawn in the first place. Perhaps you will be the one who can finally tip the scales back in our favor. Now here's a little something for you.
Lady Claudia: Not at all! It's the least we could do! Now, how about you take a small break, and come to me when you're good and ready to continue, hmm?

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Lady Claudia: It does indeed! We wouldn't put you through all that training and then not make use of it, would we? Now, I need to tell you about a place called the Sanctum of Dawn . It's a place filled with a great many treasures, including halls lined with seal stones gathered from every corner of…

links.text: "So that's where the Priests of Dawn are guarding it?"

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Lady Claudia: Yes, for now at least. I need you to sneak into the Sanctum of Dawn , take the last page of the contract , and bring it back here to me. It won't be easy, but if Collin's notes are correct, then you should have all the skills you need to complete your mission.

links.text: "You expect me to just waltz in there?"

Q00195_SevenSignsSecretRitualOfThePriest.text: Lady Claudia: Once you've been transformed , yes, exactly. They'll be so busy guarding their other entrances they won't think to check on one of their own walking through the front door, so to speak. There was one slight problem--all the guards carry unique ID cards , without which they can't gain …

Lady Claudia: Yes, the old fashioned way too--bribery! I've paid off one of the guards of the Sanctum, Captain John . He's fabricated a new card for you, and should be waiting for you right now in Gludio . If you hurry he'll still be there by the time you arrive. Go!

Q00348_AnArrogantSearch/31001-02.html.text: Claudia Athebalt: He is huge! Oh, his body! Actually, I'd rather not describe him in detail... Simply put, he is an Angel ... He has killed many of my servants. I wish someone would deal with him!
